narr: A mid level trough just north of the I-85 corridor provided the focus for the development of slow moving thunderstorms. PWAT's near two inches resulted in storms that produced high rainfall rates and flash flooding across northern Montgomery County.
ev: Flooding reported at Maxwell Air Force Base. River Road impassable and at least one building with several feet of water in the basement. Rainfall amounts of two to four inches over a three hour period reported by an observer.
Flash flooding reported in the city limits of Montgomery. Several roads flooded and impassable including Taft Street, Fairview Avenue, Cloverdale, Zelda Road and Ann Street.
